verdict.rationale: The Department of State's pages confirm that an online filing system exists. None of them say whether a founder can start that filing flow without an account, or whether it can be entered by file number. The filing-app host could not be fetched, and a public entity-search database is a different capability from starting a filing. Account-free entry to the core online flow is therefore unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
